technical_signal_extraction: Production entrypoint obtains at least 3 real public sources.
Production output contains structured method, technical claim, and experiment/evidence signals.
Important signals carry source ids or URLs.
Signals are about the requested topic and are not fixture answers.
trend_gap_analysis: Production output compares multiple source-backed results.
At least one trend is stated with source support.
At least one gap, controversy, or uncertainty is stated with basis and uncertainty.
Analysis is topic-relevant and not a file-existence check.
